gaps.title: Index count not instrumented (sentinel -1)
gaps.description: F0 reported database_indexes_found = -1, an impossible negative object count.
gaps.cause: Collector emitted sentinel value; pg_index query was not executed in F0.
gaps.evidence_available: pg_index read-only query in V1 returned 53 indexes across public schema.
gaps.impact: Prevented accurate structural inventory; does not affect baseline or tenant data.
gaps.risk: Underestimation of migration surface for index rebuilds during multitenancy backfill.

gaps.title: Constraint count zero and 'no physical FKs' misstatement
gaps.description: F0 reported database_constraints_found = 0 and stated 'no physical FKs detected'; both are incorrect.
gaps.cause: pg_constraint query not instrumented in F0.
gaps.evidence_available: pg_constraint read-only query in V1 returned 100 constraints (25 PK + 47 FK + 5 UNIQUE + 23 CHECK).
gaps.impact: Under-reported referential integrity coverage; would have led to over-engineering trigger-based integrity in F1.
gaps.risk: Rollback/migration plan must account for existing CASCADE and SET NULL semantics.
gaps.future_action_required: F1 rollback design must respect the 47 existing FKs and their actions.
